comment: The mode CV is named "Mode CV (0-10V -> 4 modes)" by the maker (gravity.cpp:286) but gravity.cpp:403 divides the 10V by a sixth of its span and clamps to the six modes, so the tooltip is out of date. The gravity control means something different in each mode, so its tooltip reading in degrees is right only for the pendulum and the billiards.
